assets.name: Outer Market (Verath's Walls)
assets.prompt_or_direction: A busy medieval market at morning beneath high stone walls: distant haggling voices, wooden cart wheels rattling over cobbles, a blacksmith's hammer ringing far off, sparrows and morning birds, gentle wind, and a faint cold crystalline hum near the gate. Grounded, weathered, seamless loop, no music.

assets.name: The Undermarket
assets.prompt_or_direction: An underground black market in old brick sewer tunnels: steady dripping water, slow dark river lapping against stone, echoing hushed murmurs, pitch torches crackling, and a faint metallic clank in the distance. Claustrophobic, tense, seamless loop, no music.

assets.name: The Fracture Core
assets.prompt_or_direction: A vast circular black stone chamber: a deep sub-bass low hum, sharp glass-like crackles in the air, faint cold ethereal harmonic tones, and unsettling near-silence between slow resonant pulses. Awe-inspiring, ominous, seamless loop, no music.

assets.name: Verath (Capital Overview)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Dusk wind sweeping across slate rooftops of a vast walled city: distant muffled bells, low urban murmur far below, and a faint glassy shimmer from a huge translucent dome overhead with occasional soft static-like rift crackles. Melancholic, expansive, seamless loop, no music.

assets.name: The Ledger House
assets.prompt_or_direction: A stark, high-ceilinged stone hall: hollow room tone, dozens of dry quills scratching on heavy parchment, the crisp turn of thick ledger pages, a faint cold digital-crystalline hum from floating panes, and slow measured footsteps echoing once. Clinical, oppressive, seamless loop, no music.

assets.name: A Gate (Rift)
assets.prompt_or_direction: A quiet mist-shrouded pine forest clearing: soft wind through dry needles disrupted at the center by a pulsing electric-glass thrumming, sharp intermittent cyan energy snaps, and a hollow alien draft pulling through a tear in reality. Uncanny, hazardous, seamless loop, no music.

assets.name: System Notification
assets.prompt_or_direction: A clean crystalline chime with a soft digital shimmer, cold and precise, crisp high-frequency tail, no music.

assets.name: Class Awakening
assets.prompt_or_direction: A rising arcane energy swell building rapidly into a resonant glassy impact with a cold cyan harmonic shimmer, otherworldly and weighty, no music.

assets.name: Warden's Whistle (Caught)
assets.prompt_or_direction: A sharp, piercing metal pea-whistle blast echoing off stone walls, immediately followed by quick heavy leather boots running on cobblestones, no music.

assets.name: Level Up
assets.prompt_or_direction: A bright ascending three-note crystalline chime with a soft harmonic glow and clean resonant decay, rewarding yet restrained, no music.

assets.name: Combat — Sword Hit (Armour)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Heavy iron sword striking plate armour: sharp metallic clang, punchy low-mid impact thud, brief steel ring, grounded and visceral, no music.

assets.name: Combat — Fireball Cast & Burst
assets.prompt_or_direction: Arcane flame ignition: quick rushing air whoosh building into a tight, punchy fiery burst with crackling ember tail, no music.

assets.name: Combat — Crystal Shattering
assets.prompt_or_direction: Heavy massive crystal shattering: deep crystalline fracture crack followed by a dense cascade of sharp glass and stone shards hitting wet rock, no music.

assets.name: Ledger Seal / Entry Logged
assets.prompt_or_direction: Heavy iron stamp thudding firmly onto thick parchment, followed by a subtle cold crystalline chime confirming a System record, no music.

assets.name: Health Potion (Use)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Tight cork popping from a small glass vial, brief liquid glug, and a subtle warm breathy arcane shimmer, no music.

assets.name: Rift / Gate Transition
assets.prompt_or_direction: Sharp glass-tearing crackle followed by a sudden vacuum whoosh and low resonant pressure drop as reality shifts, no music.

assets.name: Exploring (Aethoria / Wilds)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Melancholic dark-fantasy ambient instrumental: expressive solo cello, soft muted string swells, distant cold choir pads, sparse felt piano notes, slow unhurried tempo, weathered and bleak with a subtle hopeful undertone. Seamless loop, no vocals, no heavy percussion.

assets.name: Combat (Standard)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Tense dark-fantasy orchestral combat instrumental: driving low cellos and double basses playing urgent ostinatos, thunderous taiko drums, sharp muted brass stabs, and crisp metallic percussion accents. Grounded, relentless, seamless loop, no lyrics.

assets.name: The Ledger / Verath
assets.prompt_or_direction: Cold and orderly dark-fantasy instrumental: precise mechanical ticking clock rhythm, tight staccato strings, a low hushed male choir pad, and sparse icy celesta pulses. Bureaucratic, quietly menacing, clinical, seamless loop.

assets.name: Boss Encounter (Core / Tribunal)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Massive dark-fantasy boss battle orchestral instrumental: booming war drums, aggressive brass swells, frantic dissonant strings, cold crystalline synth undertones, and dramatic low choir accents. Overwhelming, ominous, seamless loop.

assets.name: Safe Haven (Mira's Inn / Rest)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Quiet, weary dark-fantasy tavern ambient instrumental: solitary plucked lute and warm low acoustic drone, subtle bowed viola harmonies, intimate and understated, slightly melancholic warmth. Seamless loop, no percussion.

assets.name: The System (Priority)
assets.prompt_or_direction: Neutral, genderless, calm synthetic voice; crisp, precise diction; slight cold digital resonance; zero emotion; flat, even pacing with clean pauses between sentences.
sample_lines: The System has reported you to the Ledger.

assets.name: Auditor Imre Castell
assets.prompt_or_direction: Quiet, measured male voice, fifties; clipped, educated, and precise; cool dry texture; never raises his voice, letting silence carry the threat.
sample_lines: We are not good. We are not cruel. We are accurate.
Your rank is not a suggestion, citizen. Discrepancies are corrected at the Ledger House.

assets.name: Silas the Fence
assets.prompt_or_direction: Soft, smooth, amused male voice, early forties; conspiratorial half-whisper with a relaxed cadence and a slight knowing smile audible in the tone.
sample_lines: I don't steal. I just make sure stolen things find a good home.
Wardens hate getting their coats wet. So long as the river's up, we can talk business.

assets.name: Torven, the Blacksmith
assets.prompt_or_direction: Gruff, gravelly older male voice, mid-fifties; slow, deliberate, and economical with words; weathered baritone with quiet warmth underneath.
sample_lines: Steel doesn't care what rank a blue box gave you. Keep the edge true.
Thirty years at the anvil, and the System calls me a Journeyman. Sit down, let me see that blade.

assets.name: A Ledger Warden
assets.prompt_or_direction: Flat, firm, bored authority; late twenties to thirties; clipped institutional delivery, emotionally detached, speaks like reading from a checklist.
sample_lines: Your record doesn't balance. Pay, or come with us.
Halt. Present your System mark and state your business inside Verath's walls.

assets.name: Mira, the Innkeeper
assets.prompt_or_direction: Sharp, pragmatic female voice, early forties; brisk urban cadence, dry alto texture, guarded and observant, warms slightly only for regulars.
sample_lines: Keep the arcane arts out of my taproom and pay in copper—not System promises.
You learn to watch the latch in Verath, or you don't last a season.

assets.name: The Gray Wanderer
assets.prompt_or_direction: Soft, hushed, ageless voice (indeterminate 35–50); unhurried, eerily even cadence; slightly hollow, quiet resonance as if speaking from just out of sight.
sample_lines: People look straight through what the System refuses to label.
The Fracture did not break Aethoria. It only showed you where the cracks were waiting.

assets.name: The Eager Scout
assets.prompt_or_direction: Cheerful young woman, early twenties; quick, chatty, bright energy with light conversational inflections and slight nervous excitement.
sample_lines: Hey, did you see that rift flicker? Tell me we're actually going in there!

assets.name: The Cynical Sellsword
assets.prompt_or_direction: Dry, world-weary male, late thirties; relaxed, slightly gravelly drawl, sardonic undertone, unhurried delivery.
sample_lines: Another low-rank contract, another dark tunnel. Let's grab the loot before the Wardens show up.

assets.name: The Bookish Arcanist
assets.prompt_or_direction: Precise, slightly breathless young man, mid-twenties; articulate, slightly fast when excited about the arcane arts, tentative in combat.
sample_lines: Fascinating—the arcane resonance near the Fracture Core is completely off the Ledger's charts.

assets.name: The Pragmatic Veteran
assets.prompt_or_direction: Steady, no-nonsense female, late forties; grounded, calm mid-range voice, brisk and dependable, zero melodrama.
sample_lines: Check your potions, watch the flanks, and don't let that thing corner you.
